purpose: Bar or line chart drawn from a project CSV, with direct value labels and units.
accessibility: Every value is printed beside its mark, and the x labels and the unit are always drawn, so the data never depends on colour. The series uses the theme accent token; text uses the theme text and muted text tokens, a pair that meets WCAG AA. The optional caption is a paragraph under the chart. Labels wrap inside the safe area; the text is not shrunk.
